verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUTENDE nnyo Mukama
-Olw'okutulabirira;
Ye nsibuko y'essanyu,
Tumwebaze Mukama.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Laba-eby'okukungula
Byengedde mu nnimiro;
Naffe ka tusanyuke
-Okutuusa bulijjo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Emmere gye tusiga,
Tutunuulira oyo
Afukirira-ettaka
Okukuza-ebibala.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ka tukutendereze
Ggwe nannyini kwagala;
Kubanga mu ggwe wekka
Mwe tufuna-obulamu.
